title: Adyen pricing - Interchange++ plus monthly platform fee, $500+ minimum volume
clean_text: Adyen uses an Interchange++ model: the card issuer's interchange fee plus the card network's scheme fee plus Adyen's own processing fee, typically around EUR0.10 per transaction plus roughly 0.6% or higher depending on volume. On top of per-transaction fees, Adyen charges a one-time setup fee of EUR500-EUR5,000+ depending on integration complexity, a mandatory monthly platform fee of EUR120-EUR300, and a EUR100 monthly minimum fee. For a representative $100 US card transaction, total fees run roughly $2.40-$3.75 depending on card type.
